{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

data_clean = data[~data['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_data = data_clean[data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
converted_loyal = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_data)
conversion_rate = converted_loyal / total_loyal

# Print the values that will be used in evidence
print(f"converted_loyal = {converted_loyal}")
print(f"total_loyal = {total_loyal}")
print(f"conversion_rate = {conversion_rate}")

# Return the final value for submission
conversion_rate"}
